summary: Frontend UI verification of 4 admin fixes (S31 batch): store/identity gate persistence, 30s silent polling, new-lead banner, Hiboutik button removal, Relance Email no-blank-tab. 5 of 6 checks PASS. Banner (FIX2b) fails specifically for store='test' because /api/admin/latest filters out is_test=True leads — a backend contract mismatch, not a frontend regression. Login via david.m@repairandco.fr + Lattes/Magasin TEST gate works. Created exactly 2 test leads (one for FIX2b with store='test', then one retry) — total compliant with user's minimal-volume policy for banner verification.

critical.issue: Hard-codes query `is_test: {$ne: True}` so test-store leads are NEVER returned, even when `store=test` is passed. This breaks the new-lead banner (FIX2b) for the Magasin TEST — polling tick fetches 0 results, baseline never updates to the fresh test lead, banner never fires. Must mirror the `/admin/to-call` logic (if store==TEST_STORE_ID: query.is_test=True else is_test {$ne:True}).

integration_issues.issue: Banner never appears when a lead is created via POST /api/quote with store='test', because /api/admin/latest returns empty for test store (backend filter). Verified: lead creation returns 200, 'À appeler' count increments 47→48, but [data-testid=admin-new-lead-banner] never renders within 45s of creation across 2 attempts.

integration_issues.flow: Polling baseline reset on storeFilter change
integration_issues.issue: lastSeenCreatedAtRef is NOT reset when storeFilter changes in the polling useEffect (line 564-649 of AdminPage.jsx). After switching stores, the baseline from the previous store may still gate detection in the new store, potentially suppressing a legitimate banner. Minor compared to the backend bug above.

action_items: BACKEND: fix /api/admin/latest to allow test-store leads when store='test' is explicitly requested (mirror /admin/to-call pattern around TEST_STORE_ID at server.py:1551-1580). Without this, the FIX2b banner is unverifiable for the test store and will not fire in real usage either.
FRONTEND (minor): reset lastSeenCreatedAtRef.current = null inside the polling useEffect when storeFilter changes, so a new store starts with a clean baseline (AdminPage.jsx around line 564).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.jsx is ~1859 lines — above the 700-line guideline. Should be split into subcomponents (StoreGateModal, IdentityModal, ToCallList, NewLeadBanner, PollingProvider).
server.py is ~2789 lines — same split recommendation. Admin endpoints in particular could move to a dedicated admin_router module.
Polling useEffect has 11 dependencies — makes it error-prone; wrapping handlers in refs would make the effect idempotent across incidental re-renders.

rca_of_the_issue: FIX2b banner silent-fail root cause: GET /api/admin/latest (server.py:1551-1580) hardcodes {is_test: {$ne: True}} in the Mongo query before applying the store filter. When the admin UI polls with store='test' (because the manager selected 'Magasin TEST' from the store gate), the query becomes {is_test: {$ne: True}, store: 'test'} which never matches any document (test leads always carry is_test=True). The polling tick therefore sees arr=[] on every call, baseline is set to null, no 'fresh' is ever computed, and setNewLeadBanner is never invoked. Fix: branch on store == TEST_STORE_ID in get_latest_demands exactly like get_to_call_list does (set is_test=True + store=TEST_STORE_ID when test is explicitly requested, else keep the current filter). Reproduction: login as admin → pick 'Magasin TEST' from gate → wait 35s → POST /api/quote with store='test' → observe banner never appears despite the lead showing up in À-appeler list (which uses a different, correctly-branched endpoint).
